generations.prompt: Late afternoon, low golden sun from the side, long shadows. Medium shot inside a deep excavation trench. A bearded man in an olive cap, in muted field clothes, knee pads and blue nitrile gloves, stands shoulder-deep against the dark earth wall of the trench and swings a long-handled pick into the wall at chest height, steadily, again and again; clods of dark wet earth fall at his feet beside a black puddle; dust drifts through the shaft of sunlight. Behind him the trench wall rises to the rim, a taut string line and a strip of sky. He does not look at the camera. Camera is fixed, no camera movement. No music, no speech. No on-screen text, no captions, no watermark.
